e1_intro_1: Four gigantic lighthouse towers floating in deep space, each crowned with a glowing prism crystal that sends beams of light through a dark violet nebula; tiny starships with engines glowing follow the light lanes between the stars.
e1_intro_2: A young cadet in a chunky orange and white spacesuit with a big round helmet and a cyan visor repairs a glowing panel in a clean blue-steel space station corridor; colourful graduation pennants with a small lighthouse emblem hang from the ceiling; warm and cosy mood.
e1_intro_3: A fleet of black angular machine spacecraft with cold magenta lights fires beams at a giant space lighthouse; its prism crystal shatters into glowing shards that scatter across the black of space; dramatic.
e1_intro_4: An older woman officer with short silver hair in a navy and gold uniform with a small lighthouse emblem speaks into a radio microphone on the bridge of a space station; red alarm lights, consoles and a window onto a blue ringed gas giant.
e1_outro_1: A huge ring-shaped space station orbiting a blue ringed gas giant; on its rim a tall lighthouse tower shines again with a bright cyan prism light; peaceful.
e1_outro_2: A small orange shuttle flies towards a lush green moon with swirling clouds, a ringed giant planet behind it, stars around; adventurous mood.
e2_intro_1: The surface of an alien jungle moon: gigantic umbrella-shaped trees, mossy ruins of an ancient vanished civilisation, bioluminescent blue and violet plants, two moons in a teal sky, mist between the trees.
e2_intro_2: A vast underground insect hive cavern with honeycomb walls, glowing amber egg sacs, resin drips and organic pillars; something huge moves in the shadows at the back.
e2_outro_1: A tall ancient stone lighthouse tower rising above an alien jungle canopy shines a bright green prism light into the dusk sky.
e2_outro_2: A bright comet with a long glowing tail in space; tiny drill rigs with yellow lights stand on its icy surface; stars and a distant sun.
e3_intro_1: Inside a comet's ice mine: deep frozen shafts with wooden and steel supports, lanterns, a drill rig, rails, and glowing violet and cyan crystals growing out of the ice walls.
e3_intro_2: Chunky orange and yellow mining robots with drills, their eyes glowing red, march through an icy tunnel lit by crystal light; a little menacing but cartoonish.
e3_outro_1: A comet's tail glowing brightly in space, lit by a crystal lighthouse tower standing on the comet's icy surface.
e3_outro_2: A colossal black angular warship with cold magenta lights and spikes hangs in front of a burning red planet; small fighters around it; ominous.
e4_intro_1: Inside a giant warship: glowing orange forges and molten metal channels, black iron walkways, and further back neon magenta circuit corridors in darkness.
e4_intro_2: A small orange shuttle sneaks along the black armoured hull of a colossal alien warship covered in spikes and magenta lights; stars and a red planet below.
e4_outro_1: A cold machine core of black crystal and magenta light breaks apart into bright white and cyan light inside a dark chamber; shards of light fly outwards.
e4_outro_2: A ceremony in a bright hall of a space station: an older woman officer with silver hair in a navy and gold uniform pins a small golden badge on a young cadet in an orange and white spacesuit holding his helmet under his arm; a crowd of cadets in uniforms cheers.
e4_outro_3: A small starship with glowing engines flies home along a lane of shining lighthouse towers through a starry violet nebula; hopeful, the end of a journey.
